content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the entire lengthy video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Here is a highlights clip of the event for you to watch.

Apple releases event highlights clip

In addition to the iPhone Duo — Apple's first foldable iPhone — Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation support.

The event lasted approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, continuing Apple's signature style with executives speaking directly to camera, interspersed with marketing demonstrations and product commercials.

If you really don't have time to watch the entire event, Apple has also released a fun highlights video, featuring a narrator walking you through the entire launch in fast-forward and rewind, summarising the key points of each product announcement.

Apple has also uploaded the full introduction video for each product, all of which can be viewed below.
